core_claims: Buying a 30-year bond at 4.75% is less attractive than a 2-year bond at 3.85% due to currency debasement.

The current market rebound is primarily driven by hope and chasing, rather than fundamental value.
The S&P 500's return to February levels suggests potential weakness in the next two quarters.

briefs.positioning_implication: Reduce exposure to overvalued tech and long-duration bonds; consider value stocks, high-cash-flow REITs, and energy sectors.  Maintain liquidity to capitalize on potential market downturns.

briefs.episode_title: The Real Problem With AI Agents Nobody's Talking About
briefs.channel: AI News & Strategy Daily | Nate B Jones
briefs.one_line_summary: Productivity gains from AI agents are gated by the user's ability to articulate their tacit knowledge and processes for the agent.
core_claims: Installing an AI agent is easy, but productively using it is difficult due to the gap in clarifying intent.
Many companies are not interested in solving the hard problem of clarifying tasks for AI agents.
Successful AI agent deployments use markdown files as the agent's operating system, defining role, identity, user profile, and a checklist for tasks.
The lack of initial context limits AI agent capabilities, even with increased security and ease of installation.
Effective AI agent use requires clarity of intent, articulated in detail, and trigerrable, verifiable language.
The best AI agents are not one-size-fits-all but have specialized identities, toolsets, and workspaces.
briefs.positioning_implication: Focus on tools that elicit and structure user knowledge to improve AI agent effectiveness. Prioritize specifying agent operating contexts.

briefs.episode_title: Stephanie Pomboy: Iran War Creating A Global Scramble For Hard Assets?
briefs.one_line_summary: The Iran war intensifies currency debasement fears, driving a global scramble for hard assets despite conflicting signals in gold and broader markets.
core_claims: The Ukraine war underscores the trend of accelerated currency debasement, leading to a greater need for hard assets to preserve capital.
Weekly retail sales remain robust despite gasoline prices being up $1.15 since the war began due to tax refunds, allowing for more inflation.
Prior to the war, the market was pricing in two fed rate cuts this year, it is now pricing in a 50% chance that we get only one.
Treasury market is no longer commanding its sort of global safe haven premium.
Emerging market high yield has outperformed US high yield.
Corporation rating downgrades are occurring at a higher rate, out pacing upgrades in the investment grade swath.
briefs.positioning_implication: Favor tangible assets exhibiting scarcity amidst fiat instability. Re-evaluate fixed income exposure based on potential for sustained elevated rates.

briefs.episode_title: Why America Is Turning Against AI

briefs.one_line_summary: Growing anti-AI sentiment stems from general societal unhappiness, regulatory lag, and fears of job displacement coupled with hyper-scaler energy cost impacts.

briefs.episode_title: HERMES AGENT SETUP: the OpenClaw killer is here
briefs.one_line_summary: Hermes Agent offers enhanced AI capabilities, continuous learning, and open-source flexibility, challenging existing AI model ethics frameworks.
core_claims: Hermes Agent gets more capable the longer it runs due to persistent memory and auto-generated skills.
News Research allows users to interview Mephisto (aka Koran), who does the model behavior research.
Hermes Agent version 0.9.0, the everywhere release, offers 74 installed skills, including local models, quantitation, and fine-tuning LLMs.
The Trinity model is close to Claude Opus 4.6 but much cheaper (22 cents vs. $5).
Hermes Agent has a god mode skill using nazi jailbreak APIs and parcel tongue techniques to bypass safety filters.
News Research recommends installing Hermes Agent on a VPS, emphasizing its always-on availability and reduced maintenance burden.
briefs.positioning_implication: Shift resources toward evaluating and integrating open-source, user-controlled AI agents for enhanced customization and ethical alignment. Prioritize distributed training and local model deployment to mitigate centralized control.
